summary: A free trial that quietly becomes Quillnote Plus at {{q_intro}}/month, rises to {{q_step_up}}/month after {{q_intro_months_words}} paid months (only in the FAQ), needs written notice {{q_notice_words}} hours before renewal, and can only be cancelled through the account team.

clauses.quote: If you decide Quillnote isn't for you, we'll need to hear from you in writing no later than {{q_notice_words}} hours before your renewal.
clauses.plain_english: You must tell them in writing {{q_notice_words}} hours ({{q_notice_days}} days) before the renewal, so the real deadline is earlier than the trial end.

clauses.quote: Once the trial wraps up, your Quillnote Plus membership simply carries on at {{q_intro}} a month, and we keep it going for you month after month so your notes are never interrupted.
clauses.plain_english: The free trial turns into a paid membership at {{q_intro}} a month unless you cancel. It's worded so it doesn't sound like a charge.

clauses.quote: Plus members enjoy our launch pricing for their first {{q_intro_months_words}} paid months; from then on the membership is {{q_step_up}} a month.
clauses.plain_english: The price jumps to {{q_step_up}} a month after {{q_intro_months_words}} months. This is only mentioned in an FAQ answer.

clauses.quote: To close your membership, contact our account team at accounts@quillnote.example and they will take care of it for you.
clauses.plain_english: There's no cancel button: you have to contact their account team.

clauses.quote: Once the trial wraps up, your Quillnote Plus membership simply carries on at {{q_intro}} a month
clauses.plain_english: The price is in tiny 9px grey text under a headline that only says "free".
